note: Roqbot, the social jukebox app of Garrett Dodge and Ketu Patel, which started at San Francisco's Bar Basic, is Rockbot: TechCrunch's Rockbot stories of 2014-08-27 and 2015-02-13 carry the same CEO and the same start at Bar Basic, and the 2015 one lists Google Ventures among Rockbot's backers. note: Spruce Health (sprucehealth.com), founded in 2013 by former Kleiner Perkins partner Ray Bradford: an asynchronous dermatology app, now a HIPAA-compliant phone, text and fax platform for medical practices (its own site, still selling plans with 2025 billing changes). Not Spruce Finance (its own row). Kleiner Perkins led its $2M seed with Baseline and Cowboy Ventures, without GV (TechCrunch, 2014-09-25). Vogue (2015-04-01) names Google Ventures among its investors, the firm lists it from an April 2015 capture (partner Blake Byers), and its one Form D (filed 2015-04-21) reports $15M of equity sold to 11 investors from a first sale on 2014-09-17. No source read names the round GV entered (a later close of the seed or a Series A), so the stage is undetermined and no graduation applies. Private, below_1b; San Francisco (116 New Montgomery Street on its Form D).

Fractyl Health (formerly Fractyl Laboratories), procedures and therapies for metabolic disease (Revita), Burlington, Massachusetts (3 Van de Graaff Drive on EDGAR; Lexington in 2017). GV joined the $44M Series D as a new investor, GV General Partner Krishna Yeshwant quoted (the company's release, 2017-11-30): Growth, no graduation. On none of the firm's lists. Public since its 2024 IPO (NASDAQ: GUTS); market cap $77.39M on 2026-09-29 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/guts/market-cap/), so the below_1b band from the $49.6M float stands; the float joins CIK 1572616, Fractyl Health itself. Aligned with the General Catalyst row on status, band, country and city.

Fulcrum Therapeutics, small molecules that modulate gene regulation in genetic diseases, Cambridge, Massachusetts (26 Landsdowne Street on EDGAR), launched by Third Rock Ventures in 2016. GV added to its Series A: the company's release of 2017-05-10 announces 'additional Series A funding from GV', Krishna Yeshwant quoted: Series A, no graduation. On none of the firm's lists. Public (NASDAQ: FULC); market cap $283.83M on 2026-09-29 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/fulc/market-cap/), below_1b.

Lyell Immunopharma, T-cell therapies for solid tumors, South San Francisco (201 Haskins Way on EDGAR). GV 2019, L.P. is a party to its amended and restated investors' rights agreement of 2020-03-05, made with the Series C purchase agreement (S-1 exhibit 4.2), and the firm's own post of 2022-01-06 calls it 'GV portfolio company Lyell Immunopharma'; it is on none of the firm's lists. The S-1 names no GV holding and no source names the round GV bought: the Series A closed in tranches from September 2018 to February 2019 ($179.1M), the Series B from March to May 2019 ($162.1M) and the Series C in March 2020 ($493.0M), so the stage is undetermined and no graduation applies. Public since its 2021 IPO (NASDAQ: LYEL) and still filing in September 2026; market cap $232.55M on 2026-09-29 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/lyel/market-cap/), so the known public below_1b stands. The 8VC row's acquired status (a 2025 takeover in its note) is contradicted by the live listing.

Singular Genomics Systems, next-generation sequencing instruments, San Diego (its headquarters in La Jolla; 3010 Science Park Road on EDGAR). GV 2017, L.P. is on the investor schedule of its amended and restated investors' rights agreement of 2019-06-27, made with the Series B purchase agreement for holders of the Series Seed (2016, $4.5M), Series A (2017, $20.0M) and Series B (2019, two closings, $45.0M; S-1 and its exhibit 4.2); it is on none of the firm's lists. No source names the round GV bought (the Series A or the Series B), so the stage is undetermined and no graduation applies. Listed in 2021 (NASDAQ: OMIC); an affiliate of Deerfield Management, already a holder, bought the rest at $20.00 a share and the deal closed on 2025-02-21 (the company's release, San Diego dateline, https://www.manilatimes.net/2025/02/21/tmt-newswire/globenewswire/singular-genomics-announces-closing-of-acquisition-by-deerfield-management/2060397): acquired, below_1b. Aligned with the Coatue row on status, country and city.
